personas.name: Creative Systems Lead
personas.job: Coordinate brand, design, content, motion and AI production without losing consistency or control.
personas.pain: Fragmented tools, duplicated briefs, generic outputs, manual QA and weak traceability.
personas.desired: One governed workflow from intent to approved artifact.
personas.proof: Reusable systems, preview/apply controls, auditability, high-quality outputs and interoperability.

personas.name: Product & Design Leader
personas.job: Increase design throughput and quality while protecting product coherence and trust.
personas.pain: AI experimentation creates inconsistency, risk and unclear ownership.
personas.desired: Scalable creative operations with measurable quality and clear governance.
personas.proof: Design tokens, role-based authority, reversible changes, testable outputs and adoption metrics.

personas.name: Independent Creator / Builder
personas.job: Turn ambitious ideas into polished multi-format output without assembling a complex toolchain.
personas.pain: Context switching, prompt trial-and-error, inconsistent branding and technical barriers.
personas.desired: A guided but flexible studio that preserves personal direction.
personas.proof: Templates, intelligent briefs, modular workflows, export portability and clear controls.

personas.name: Enterprise Innovation & Governance
personas.job: Enable responsible AI adoption while managing data, security, audit and vendor risk.
personas.pain: Opaque automation, uncontrolled data flows, unapproved models and untraceable changes.
personas.desired: Bounded, inspectable and policy-aligned creative AI operations.
personas.proof: No secret leakage, authority gates, audit logs, signed/static assets and controlled integrations.

personas.name: Agency / Studio Operations Lead
personas.job: Deliver more client work without diluting strategy, craft or margins.
personas.pain: Non-repeatable process, version chaos and inconsistent external output.
personas.desired: Reusable client systems, faster production and quality control.
personas.proof: Brand kits, workflow templates, review gates, reusable components and client-safe exports.
